notes.title: 1.0.10 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello players! Today we bring you the 1.0.10 update of Endless Thunder

Update the content

Although there are not many updates, some minor problems and the story of the game have been improved

・Added some story and option branches

Added some BGMs

・Added the main interface

Restored shortcut menu bar

・Modified the prompt when the game is started

We will continue to update the game and strive to bring a better gaming experience to everyone!
